{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Filter out QA orders
real_orders = df[~qa_mask]

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = real_orders[
    (real_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (real_orders['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')
print(f'Number of real orders: {len(real_orders)}')
print(f'Number of LOYAL completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')"}
